axes_in_declared_order.meaning: (c_min, c_max): starting liquid capital, linear across firms
axes_in_declared_order.name: capital
axes_in_declared_order.spacing_rule: c_min in {0.5, 1.0, 1.5} x s_L (s_L = 100, manual 9.2); c_max = 2 x c_min, so the axis spans 0.5x to 3x s_L

axes_in_declared_order.meaning: (cap_min, cap_max): capability c, linear across firms
axes_in_declared_order.name: capability
axes_in_declared_order.spacing_rule: cap_min in {0.30, 0.45}; cap_max = 2 x cap_min (same max = 2 x min rule as capital)

cell_order: itertools.product over the axes in the order listed; the last axis varies fastest; cell index = position in that product (0-based)

controls.a_determinism: cell 0: baseline and the shocked run at shock seed 910001 are each run twice; the event logs must be byte-equal
controls.b_known_failure: the R12 slice config (4-firm smoke population, observation.delayed, magnitude 0.3 / 0.1) evaluated with the same code over shock seeds 910001..910020 must fail the targets

declared_before_any_run_note: Written before any run, from reading the code only: with the population rule above no firm starts with an obligation, and the only source of obligation is an applied 'contract' shaping effect (firma-domain effect.rs). SC-3 needs g_4 = q - theta_Q >= 0 with theta_Q = 100 at least once. Whether that can happen in this rule set is NOT established here. If it cannot, SC-3 and therefore T1 fail in every cell; the grid and targets are left exactly as the task specifies, and an information-only column reports T1 with the obligation leg left out.

fixed_items_ASSUMPTIONS.decision: decision.satisficing with the base config's params (l_w = 4; all else plugin defaults)

kept_from_base_config.market actions and resolve_lagged: as in the base config, default params

fixed_items_ASSUMPTIONS.observation: observation.full replaces the base config's observation.delayed (so decision-time h = true h)
fixed_items_ASSUMPTIONS.shock: shock.stochastic replaces shock.scheduled: id rand-reg, channel regulatory/theta_limit, onset uniform 10..80, ramp instant, persistence permanent, observability full, novelty 0.5, targets all; magnitude per the grid

per_cell_procedure.baseline: one NO-SHOCK run (shock rule removed, shock seed 910001); firma_lab.metrics.sanity_report gives SC-1..SC-6
per_cell_procedure.fork_note: every fork is executed; a fork whose events.ndjson is byte-identical (sha256) to the cell's baseline reuses the baseline's measurement instead of being re-parsed; a fork that differs is measured on its own
per_cell_procedure.shocked: 20 shocked runs, shock seeds 910001..910020, each paired with its no-shock fork (same config and seeds, shock rule removed); matched firm-tick DeltaH per the R14 definition (scripts/exploratory_e1_slice.py::matched_summary)

population_template_rule.capability: firm i gets cap_min + i * (cap_max - cap_min) / (n - 1), rounded to 6 decimals
population_template_rule.capital: firm i gets round_half_up(c_min + i * (c_max - c_min) / (n - 1))
population_template_rule.every_other_per_firm_field: copied from firm 0 of the base config (configs/experiments/phase2-stage5-smoke.json): input stock 40, legitimacy 1.0, aspiration_capital_growth 8.0; no obligation, no other aspiration

question: does any cell give a stressed-but-alive population?
reported_for_information_only_NOT_target: sc2_survival_attention and sc2_pass (the focus-based SC-2 that firma_analysis applies its own bounds to)
sc3_binds per constraint [solvency, compliance, scope, obligation]
whether T1 would hold with the obligation leg of SC-3 left out

T1_baseline.SC-2: sc2_reconstructed_h_below_crit (share of live firm-ticks with h < h_crit) in [0.05, 0.25]
T1_baseline.SC-3: sc3_pass from firma_analysis (each of the four constraints binds at least once)
T1_baseline.rule: T1 passes iff all four hold

T2_shocked.mean_survival: mean over the 20 shocked runs of survivors / n lies in [0.40, 0.90]
T2_shocked.nonzero_fraction: at least 0.50 of the 20 shocked runs have matched DeltaH != 0 (exactly)
